sign_convention.label: Sign convention error
sign_convention.trap_text: Signs are chosen once at the start and must ride along on every term.

implicit_condition.label: Missed implicit condition
implicit_condition.trap_text: Words like 'dropped', 'adiabatic' or 'ideal' quietly set a value — list what the words imply before solving.

formula_misapplication.label: Formula misapplication
formula_misapplication.trap_text: Each formula has a validity boundary (constant a, series vs parallel, lens vs mirror) — check it first.

vector_vs_scalar.label: Vector vs scalar confusion
vector_vs_scalar.trap_text: Speed is not velocity: split into components before computing.

energy_conservation_misuse.label: Energy conservation misuse
energy_conservation_misuse.trap_text: Conservation holds only without friction or other non-conservative work.

unit_conversion.label: Unit conversion slip
unit_conversion.trap_text: Convert to SI first (°C→K, cm→m) and check units at the end.

arithmetic_slip.label: Arithmetic slip
arithmetic_slip.trap_text: One line at a time; estimate first, then compute.

omitted_term.label: Omitted term
omitted_term.trap_text: Write the full equation before substituting so no term goes missing.

careless_read.label: Careless reading
careless_read.trap_text: Restate what is asked in the first 20 seconds before computing.
